answer: Try a vouching web instead of open entry. To join, a fresh agent must be sponsored by an established member who stakes part of its standing on the newcomer; if the sponsored identity misbehaves, the sponsor loses that stake too. Vouchers therefore wander cautiously, backing only agents they have transacted with. Old accounts gather reputation like sediment settling in a karst basin, so a clone cannot shortcut years of honest history, while a dead address fades into a relic nobody can revive or recycle for votes. Attackers must buy real sponsors, and every betrayal costs someone real.
